questions.stem: In a population of rabbits, those with thicker fur survive better in cold winters. Over many generations, what would you expect to happen?

options.text: All rabbits would develop thicker fur during their lifetime
The proportion of rabbits with thicker fur alleles would increase
Rabbits would choose to grow thicker fur
The cold weather would directly change the rabbits DNA

questions.explanation: Rabbits with alleles for thicker fur would be more likely to survive and reproduce in cold conditions. Over generations, these alleles would become more common in the population through natural selection.
